purpose: Static pre-flight inventory of every migration file in apps/api/prisma/migrations/. Cross-checks CREATE TABLE / ADD COLUMN / ADD INDEX / ADD FK counts and identifies the migrations associated with the P3018 / MariaDB 1060 hypothesis. Stage 3 tests the hypotheses against a fresh disposable MariaDB.
scope_note: MIGRATION_CODE_DEFECT / PERSISTENT_DB_DRIFT / ENTRYPOINT_DEFECT / PROBE_CONFIGURATION_DEFECT / UNKNOWN. Stage 2 only records hypotheses; Stage 3 proves or disproves them against a truly empty database.
prisma_lockfile_note: No migration_lock.toml found in apps/api/prisma/migrations/. Prisma 6+ allows omission; if a provider-specific default is required, Prisma will infer 'mysql' from the datasource provider. No action needed.

legacy_db_init.purpose: MariaDB docker-entrypoint init scripts (auto-applied only on first boot of an empty volume via /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/). They do NOT run on prisma migrate deploy.

migrations.notes: 31 tables including auth_sessions. No IF NOT EXISTS clauses. All FKs declared in this single migration. This is the foundation; any later CREATE TABLE for one of these names will conflict.
ADDs role column. No IF NOT EXISTS / IF EXISTS. Fresh DB: success. Existing DB without role: success.

SECOND creation of auth_sessions. Uses IF NOT EXISTS so it is a no-op on a fresh DB that already has the table (created by 20260615000000_init_schema). This is consistent with init_schema already creating auth_sessions.
ADDs username and password_hash, populates username from full_name, creates UNIQUE index uq_officials_username.
Foreign keys reference officials.id with ON DELETE SET NULL.
THIRD creation of auth_sessions. Uses IF NOT EXISTS. No-op on fresh DB where auth_sessions exists from init. Sibling migration to 20260616005000; same intent, different timestamp format.
Adds is_deleted columns and indices. No IF NOT EXISTS guards.
MODIFY COLUMN to correct Vietnamese defaults. Idempotent on identical values.
Creates 5 new tables and seeds official_permissions rows for existing ADMIN officials.
Drops and recreates unique indices with scope_key. UPDATE to backfill scope_key. Not idempotent: failed execution mid-way could leave indices out of sync.
Adds Clerk identity projection. Idempotent for retry.
Audit log table for identity link/unlink. Idempotent.
Audit logs for generated documents. FKs reference officials/agencies/cases/generated_documents/generated_document_files with SET NULL on delete.

auth_sessions.issue: Primary creation in init schema without IF NOT EXISTS

prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.claim: On a truly fresh MariaDB, prisma migrate deploy applies every migration in order, exits 0, and produces a schema equivalent to the live schema.prisma.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.evidence_in_static_graph: All CREATE TABLE calls for new tables are guarded with IF NOT EXISTS or follow a fully additive path. The only existing-table name created multiple times is auth_sessions, and the two later attempts are guarded.

prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.claim: P3018 / MariaDB 1060 'Duplicate column name' is caused by drift on the persistent user DB (already-applied migrations re-marked or with manually-edited schema state), not by the migration code itself.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.evidence_in_static_graph: On a fresh DB, none of the migrations in this graph produce a 1060. The earlier CREATE TABLE for auth_sessions is unguarded only at init, and later attempts are guarded. The schema.prisma matches the union of all migrations.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.verdict_before_stage3: PLAUSIBLE - P3018 most likely depends on persistent DB drift.

prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.claim: init_schema was modified retroactively to include auth_sessions, so any existing DB that ran an older init_schema would re-encounter auth_sessions creation when re-running migrations in fresh-DB order.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.evidence_in_static_graph: init_schema.sql *does* include auth_sessions (confirmed in init_schema line 812 FK + line 925 in schema.prisma). The two later IF NOT EXISTS creations are safe no-ops. No init-schema-replay hazard on a fresh DB.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.verdict_before_stage3: REJECTED - init_schema is internally consistent with the live schema.prisma.

prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.claim: The api-entrypoint.sh runs migrate deploy with the wrong migration root or missing seed-data guard.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.evidence_in_static_graph: Entrypoint: line 48 `pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy`. Working dir `/app/apps/api`. Prisma loads the schema from `apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma` (baked into the image at COPY --from=builder). Migrations are copied as part of `apps/api/prisma`. `SEED_DATA` is gated to exactly true / false / ''.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.verdict_before_stage3: REJECTED - entrypoint is fail-closed (set -eu) and points at the correct schema.

prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.claim: An external probe (compose config, smoke script, earlier docker-verify.mjs) executed prisma migrate deploy against an already-populated user DB and reported P3018 / 1060 as a fresh-DB failure.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.evidence_in_static_graph: Indeterminate from static analysis. The Phase 7 reports cited the error but did not conclusively show the DB state at the time of the error.
prisma_migration_probe_hypotheses.verdict_before_stage3: PLAUSIBLE - requires disposable DB probe in Stage 3 to confirm or reject.

summary: Static analysis says the migration set is internally consistent with the live schema.prisma. The auth_sessions triple-creation is benign because the two later attempts use IF NOT EXISTS. The init_schema is internally consistent with the live schema. The entrypoint is fail-closed and points at the correct schema. P3018 / 1060 cannot be reproduced on a fresh DB by these migrations alone.
